overall_assessment: The living review lineage engine in searchright-living and searchright-contracts provides deterministic, tamper-evident lineage management. validate_lineage enforces review identity boundaries, acyclicity, and ancestor-bounded supersession. The record diff engine uses BLAKE3 hashing over canonical JSON and generates ordered, typed change sets. The integration test suite in multi_cycle_scenarios.rs thoroughly exercises 3-cycle lineage progression, change attribution reproduction, and human release safeguards, passing all static repository hygiene and compilation gates.

findings.description: record_digest calculates BLAKE3 hashes from serde_json::to_vec(record); ensuring stable serialization ordering in BibliographicRecord metadata is essential for cross-platform reproducibility.
findings.recommendation: Ensure serde_json Value keys in provider_metadata are normalized prior to digest generation.

findings.description: Lineage validation guarantees that a run can only supersede an ancestor in its direct parent chain, completely preventing split-brain supersession across branching review trees.
findings.recommendation: Preserve is_ancestor traversal as an immutable lineage invariant.

calibration_notes: Lineage architects endorse the directed acyclic graph supersession logic and BLAKE3 diffing with 100% test and hygiene compliance.
